explanation:
The central tree is reduced from 128 to 81 lines (36.7%) and from 8,191 to 5,406 characters (34.0%). Five connected peripherals expand evidence dependencies, node continuity, generated-edit calls, storage ownership, and read boundaries. Modular boundaries remain visible without organizing the trees by source files. Positions use measured text dimensions with gaps and no overlap.

Correction: the seed describes evidence paths as relative, but diagram.ts only rejects leading '/' and '..' segments; drive-letter absolute paths are not explicitly rejected. The evidence peripheral states the actual guard. The generated-edit peripheral clarifies that patches with retainMappings bypass the supplied mapping list, including the list computed during submission.

Source-grounded additions include source ID hash inputs and query reference behavior (diagram.ts), metadata edits preserving numeric revision while reviseDiagram issues a new revision identity (diagramRevisionEditor.ts and diagramRevision.ts), editRanges precedence (submitDiagramEdit.ts), and registry listing bypassing deferred validation (internal/revisionRegistry.ts and diagramRevisionStore.ts). Construction details come from internal/constructDiagram.ts.

Only context.json and seed.json supplied substantive evidence. Imported parser, patching, mapping-retention, and candidate-validation implementations are absent, so their internal algorithms are not inferred. Durable flush-before-publication is a documented adapter contract, not an implementation demonstrated here. No registry release operation is shown.

Immutable Diagram Revisions
|-- Shared content boundary: Diagram + DiagramRevision
|   |-- diagramId: stable service identity; Diagram.id: local content key
|   |-- revisionId = DiagramRevision.id: immutable revision identity
|   |-- parentId links a revised or derived record to its base
|   |-- Payload: ASCII, hash, parsed structure, sourceContext, highlights, jumps
|   |-- nodeRefs: parsed node ID -> persistent logical identity
|   `-- Canvas placement is external; history supplies revision bindings
|-- Construction and validation
|   |-- constructDiagram: parse ASCII with id:revision and structure kind
|   |   |-- Allocate service UUIDs; clone source data and annotations
|   |   `-- validateDiagram before returning the constructed payload
|   `-- validateDiagram: content and source integrity gate
|       |-- Require service IDs, local ID and nonnegative integer revision
|       |-- Missing service IDs on saved content -> migration-required error
|       |-- Reject legacy top-level ASCII, mappings and structure fields
|       |-- Rebuild canonical content with its parser version; compare JSON
|       |-- sourceContext.contentHash must equal SHA-256 of ASCII
|       |-- Validate annotations, local mappings and optional source binding
|       `-- Check evidence ranges and mapping-to-evidence joins
|-- Domain operations: prepare -> issue immutable revision
|   |-- createDiagram: prepareCreate -> constructDiagram -> issue
|   |   `-- No parent; allocate logical identities for parsed nodes
|   |-- reviseDiagram: prepareEdit against the supplied base
|   |   |-- Same prepared diagram object -> return the base revision
|   |   `-- Otherwise keep diagramId, allocate revisionId, set parentId
|   |-- deriveDiagram: replace content and select identities from sources
|   |   |-- Every source must belong to the base diagramId
|   |   `-- Requested refs must be allowed and identify distinct output nodes
|   `-- issueDiagramRevision
|       |-- Identity priority: explicit derived ref, carried base ref, new UUID
|       |-- Deep-freeze revision record and validate its diagram
|       `-- Return domain result; persistence and publication remain explicit
|-- Revision editor: edits and continuity
|   |-- source-mappings: require expectedContentHash to match current ASCII
|   |   `-- Clone mappings/evidence, optionally replace binding, then validate
|   |-- patch / patches: delegate range changes to patchDiagramRanges
|   |   |-- Explicit continuity extends returned correspondence; rebase highlights
|   |   `-- patches + retainMappings takes precedence over supplied mappings
|   |-- replace: rebuild at numeric revision + 1 with the same local ID
|   |   |-- Rebase existing jumps and highlights
|   |   `-- Optionally retain mappings through node correspondence
|   |-- jumps / highlights: validate replacement annotations
|   |-- correspondingNodes: infer only when ASCII and structure kind match
|   |   `-- Match unique line, start/end columns and label
|   |-- nodeCorrespondence: logical ref -> output line
|   |   `-- Reject unknown refs, ambiguous targets and conflicting claims
|   `-- merge: reject baseline/current differences; otherwise copy proposed
|-- Generated edit submission
|   |-- Check requested base revision and local diagram ownership
|   |-- Without base, replacementRanges are forbidden
|   |-- Context: base diagram, request context, or '[New diagram]' placeholder
|   |-- Validate candidate; cleaned continuity claims override caller claims
|   |   `-- Carry context source binding and evidence into generated input
|   |-- Base + requested edit ranges -> scoped replacements
|   |   |-- Preserve structure kind; compute patches and output ranges
|   |   |-- Drop mappings in replaced ranges; shift survivors and add candidates
|   |   `-- reviseDiagram(patches); return revision and replacementRanges
|   `-- Otherwise: requested base ID -> replace; no requested base ID -> create
|-- Explicit retention and runtime identity registry
|   |-- retainDiagramRevision: import, then retrieve the canonical stored record
|   |   `-- Import requires a nonempty, unique logical ref for each parsed node
|   |-- Registry install: record IDs must match embedded diagram IDs
|   |   |-- Existing ID + identical JSON signature -> reuse prior record
|   |   |-- Existing ID + different signature -> immutability error
|   |   `-- New ID -> retain a deep-frozen structured clone
|   |-- register validates diagram immediately
|   |-- restore defers diagram and logical-ref validation until get()
|   |-- get: unknown ID or failed deferred validation -> error
|   |-- assert: require stored diagram object or equal serialized payload
|   |-- listDiagramRevisions: frozen identity and parent summaries
|   `-- Stored commands compose domain operations with retention
|       `-- Adapter contract: flush retained revisions before publishing bindings
`-- Read projections
    |-- resolve(contextId, local diagramId): follow supplied revision binding
    |   |-- Unknown binding or mismatched local ID -> error
    |   |-- Return structured-cloned view with nodes expressed as logical refs
    |   `-- Include active jumps; omit source revisionId and contentHash
    `-- diagramSource / queryDiagramSourceContext
        |-- Join mapping -> evidence entity -> indexed range + binding
        `-- Expose mappings, entries, selection results and case-insensitive search

Source evidence and binding
|-- validateSourceBinding
|   |-- sourceId: nonempty string, at most 200 characters
|   |-- repositoryIdentity: nonempty string
|   |-- source-code pairs with git-worktree
|   |-- document pairs with filesystem-documents
|   `-- Corpus root starts with / or drive-letter + slash
|-- validateDiagram evidence checks
|   |-- Evidence key must equal entry.id; label must be a string
|   |-- Truthy entry.sourceId must agree with a supplied binding
|   |-- Ranges: integer start >= 1; integer end >= start
|   |-- originalLines: exactly one string per line in the interval
|   |-- Path guard: reject leading / and any .. path segment
|   |   `-- Drive-letter absolute paths are not explicitly rejected
|   `-- Mapping joins by entityId + sourceRangeIndex
|       `-- Truthy sourceRangeId must equal the selected range.id
`-- sourceBindingFromLocation
    |-- Use supplied corpus or default git-worktree at checkoutRoot
    |-- Default corpus includes gitRevision when supplied
    |-- Default domainProfileId: source-code
    `-- sourceId = source- + first 24 hex digits of SHA-256(kind:root)
        `-- Repository identity and git revision are outside this hash

Logical node continuity
|-- Editor correspondence(ref -> output line)
|   |-- Resolve logical ref back to an old parsed node
|   |-- Require integer line matching exactly one output node
|   |-- Existing inferred target must agree with the claim
|   `-- Two old nodes cannot claim the same output node
|-- deriveDiagram(base, input, refs, sources)
|   |-- Union logical refs from supplied same-diagram sources
|   |-- Send base-owned claims through editor correspondence
|   |-- Check every requested ref against the allowed union
|   |-- Require one output node per requested line
|   `-- Reject repeated target nodes; explicit identities win at issue
|-- issueDiagramRevision
|   |-- Reverse old-node -> new-node correspondence
|   `-- For each output node: explicit ref, base ref, or new node-* UUID
|-- Revision identity is distinct from numeric content revision
|   |-- source-mappings, jumps and highlights preserve numeric revision
|   `-- reviseDiagram still issues a new revisionId and parentId
`-- Same-object shortcut is conditional
    `-- ASCII equality alone does not make reviseDiagram return its base

Generated edits and mapping precedence
|-- submitDiagramEdit validates the candidate
|   |-- Validation context: base, request context, or placeholder
|   `-- Candidate continuity claims override same-key caller claims
|-- Base + edit ranges selects scoped patching
|   |-- Nonempty editRanges takes precedence over editRange
|   |-- Reject a supplied structure kind differing from the base
|   |-- scopedReplacements supplies patches and outputRanges
|   |-- Drop mappings whose starting line falls inside an input range
|   |-- Shift surviving lines by preceding replacements' length deltas
|   `-- Add generated mappings only inside output ranges
|       `-- Exclude IDs already present among retained mappings
|-- Mapping choice crosses submission and editor boundaries
|   |-- Submission sets retainMappings = !request.sourceMappings
|   |-- Truthy sourceMappings -> editor uses supplied mapping list
|   `-- Falsy sourceMappings -> retainSourceMappings supplies mappings
|       `-- The computed supplied list is bypassed in this branch
`-- Unscoped dispatch depends on request.baseRevisionId
    |-- Present -> reviseDiagram with replace
    `-- Absent -> createDiagram at numeric revision 0

Runtime retention and validation lifetime
|-- Public storage facade
|   |-- importDiagramRevision checks refs before register
|   |-- retainDiagramRevision returns registry-owned canonical objects
|   `-- Stored wrappers load required revisions, execute, then retain
|-- Internal registry owns records, signatures and pendingValidation
|   |-- install always checks record/embedded identity agreement
|   |-- Signature is JSON.stringify(record), not a semantic comparison
|   |-- New record is cloned and deep-frozen
|   `-- Existing signature match reuses the prior object
|       `-- Nondeferred install calls get, forcing pending validation
|-- restore defers full checks
|   |-- First successful get validates diagram and parsed-node refs
|   |-- Refs must be nonempty strings and unique for parsed nodes
|   |-- Remove pending marker only after validation succeeds
|   `-- list filters records directly; it does not call get
|-- listDiagramRevisions freezes summaries and their returned array
`-- Lifetime boundary in the supplied code
    |-- Retention is in runtime Maps; no release operation is shown
    `-- Durable flush-before-publication is an adapter contract comment

Read boundaries and data dependencies
|-- resolve follows context -> local diagram ID -> revision ID
|   |-- Rewrite node ID, parentId and childIds through nodeRefs
|   |-- Rewrite active jump source contentNodeId through nodeRefs
|   |-- Remove jump source revisionId and contentHash
|   `-- structuredClone the entire view; omit highlights from its shape
`-- diagramSource delegates to queryDiagramSourceContext
    |-- Join mapping.entityId -> evidence entry
    |   `-- sourceRangeIndex -> range; attach context.binding
    |-- forSelection uses mappingsForSelection before joining
    |-- search lowercases query and uses substring matching
    |   `-- Fields: entityId, entity label, range path and range symbol
    `-- context and mappings are returned by reference
        |-- Query helper itself neither clones nor freezes them
        `-- Issued and retained revision records supply frozen backing data
